Read for the Green-Kubo relation and its estimator: equation (1), the time-dependent shear viscosity V/(kB T) times the integral of the shear-stress autocorrelation; equation (3), the autocorrelation estimated as the ensemble average over independent trajectories of the time average over origins; equation (24), the viscosity as V/(kB T) times the integral of C(t) to infinity; section III, the SACF by a standard time-averaging procedure and its integral by the trapezoidal rule; equations (7) and (8), the standard errors of both under a Gaussian approximation. Critique: an arXiv preprint (v1); the journal version was not looked for, and the relation is the standard Green-Kubo one, which the paper cites to its references [38, 39] rather than derives. Refinement: cited for the relation as written and for its estimator; the errors of equations (7) and (8) are for a later skill if a run's uncertainty is wanted.
